verdict.rationale: Docs describe a clear tenant/user-scoped deletion workflow (container tags as hard boundaries, delete a container's content via API/console when a user requests deletion) and self-hosting options that keep data on the customer's own hardware, plus automatic 'forgetting of expired information.' However, there's no documented per-memory/granular delete API, no explicit retention-period controls, and no independent confirmation that deletion actually purges backing stores. missing for 10: granular single-memory deletion API docs, explicit data-retention/TTL configuration, third-party verification of deletion behavior.
